description.value: Blue Fox Cafe has been Victoria's go-to all-day breakfast spot since 1991, claiming the title of the city's first and foremost all-day breakfast restaurant. Located on Fort Street in the downtown core, it serves a broad menu of egg dishes, griddle cakes, and specialty items leaning on local and organic ingredients. Cyclists can sit down for a substantial fuel-up or grab takeout before hitting the road.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 54m; stands (2 spaces) at 60m; stands (2 spaces) at 66m; stands (2 spaces) at 69m; stands (2 spaces) at 71m; stands (2 spaces) at 97m; stands (4 spaces) at 98m. Total: 20 spaces.
